capabilities: Render the vault as a 3D black hole with notes orbiting as stars
Group notes by top-level folder, tag or clusters of linked notes
Open a note, or a new tab, by selecting its star
Show a dashboard with note, idea and link counts and most connected notes
Build a standalone HTML map from any folder of Markdown files
disambiguation: Not a note-taking app, AI or sync tool; it only draws a 3D map of notes that already exist.
extras: The Obsidian plugin is desktop only; the standalone HTML map needs a browser with WebGL2 and contains the full text of your notes, so it should not be shared. Large vaults are untested for speed, and the maximum notes setting can be lowered.
problem: A vault is hard to take in as a whole, and there is no spatial view that groups notes by folder, tag or links and opens them straight from the map.

relations.evidence: if you have Claude Code or the Claude desktop app (they can run commands on your computer), paste this

summary: 3D black hole visualization of a vault where notes orbit as stars grouped by folder, tag or links, and selecting a star opens the note.
